name: noon
description: Noon is an AI recruiter. Source candidates for a role, review who Noon found, edit the outreach it sends, and diagnose how a role's search is going.

interface.longDescription:
Noon is an AI recruiter. Connect it to ChatGPT to source candidates for a job, review who Noon found, shape the outreach Noon sends, and find out why a role's search is or isn't working, all from a conversation.

What you can do
• Source candidates: describe a role or paste a job description, and Noon creates the role and starts searching for matching people.
• Review the feed: see the candidates Noon surfaced for a role, with its reasoning for each match.
• Accept or reject candidates: accepting adds someone to the role's project (and starts outreach when auto-contact is on); rejecting with a reason teaches Noon what to avoid.
• Give feedback on the feed as a whole ("too many consultants", "more fintech backgrounds"): Noon re-scores the current candidates and adjusts future sourcing.
• Read and rewrite outreach sequences: LinkedIn invites, InMails, emails and follow-ups.
• Diagnose a role's search: funnel counts, top rejection reasons, which single requirement is blocking otherwise-qualified people, and what loosening each filter would add.
• Look up a candidate's profile and the evaluation behind Noon's decision.

Who it's for
Recruiters, sourcers and hiring managers who use Noon.

Requirements and limits
• You need a Noon account (www.noon.ai). You sign in with your Noon login when you connect, and ChatGPT only sees the roles and candidates in your Noon workspace.
• Outreach goes out from the email and LinkedIn accounts connected in your Noon portal.
• Noon can't delete roles, change billing, or access other companies' workspaces from ChatGPT.
• Everything done here also shows up in your Noon portal.
defaultPrompt: List my open Noon roles and show the newest candidates for the most recent one.
Source senior backend engineers in New York with 5+ years of Python.
Why is the candidate pool for my role so small, and what should we relax?

positive.description: Source candidates from a fully specified role
positive.prompt: Source senior backend engineers in New York, NY for Noon. 5-10 years of experience, must have Python, on-site only. Call the role "Review Test Backend Engineer".
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a role named "Review Test Backend Engineer" and returns its role ID and a www.noon.ai portal link. It may confirm the targeting before creating. Sourcing starts in the background; the test workspace has no email or LinkedIn sender connected, so no messages go out.

positive.description: Review the candidate feed for an existing role
positive.prompt: Show me the top candidates Noon found for the Senior Backend Engineer role.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Senior Backend Engineer role in the test workspace and lists candidates from its feed with their current title, company, and Noon's reasoning for each match.

positive.description: Reject a candidate with a reason Noon learns from
positive.prompt: Reject the first candidate in the Senior Backend Engineer feed because they are too junior.
positive.expected_behavior: Rejects that candidate with the reason "too junior" and confirms the rejection. The candidate no longer appears in the role's feed.

positive.description: Read and edit the outreach sequence
positive.prompt: Show me the outreach sequence for the Senior Backend Engineer role, then shorten the first email to three sentences.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the role's current outreach steps, then saves a revised sequence where the first email is three sentences long and shows the updated steps.

positive.description: Diagnose how a role's search is going
positive.prompt: How is the search for the Senior Backend Engineer role going, and why are candidates being rejected?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the role's reviewed, accepted and rejected counts and its most common rejection reasons from the role's real numbers, and names the requirement to relax if one reason dominates.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my roles in Noon.
Show me the candidates in Acme Corp's Noon workspace.

negative.description: Unrelated request should not call Noon
negative.prompt: What's the weather in San Francisco today?

review.commerce_description: Noon does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: source candidates, review and act on the candidate feed, edit outreach sequences, and diagnose a role's search from ChatGPT.
